# Command reference — SoundCraft / SML Studio 0.5.0

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo xtask docs` from the registry of this source tree. Do not edit by hand; `cargo xtask docs-check` fails when it is stale. -->

Every command this build registers (543 engine commands, 97 UI-layer commands). Search this page for an id, a label or a menu name. **Pro Tools** and **Studio One** are the default chords of the two shortcut profiles (Windows/Linux names: `Cmd` is `Ctrl`); `[unverified]` marks Studio One-style rows not yet checked against that product's manual; `[shadowed: runs …]` marks a chord this command declares but never receives, because an earlier row with the same chord wins. **Undo**: `yes` = one undo step; `no` = not on the undo stack (view, transport, file and setup actions). **Risk** is the registry's own classification (destructive = writes or replaces files or the open session). **Status** `DISABLED` rows exist in menus but do nothing. Parameters are the registry's documentation strings, exactly as the CLI, control channel and MCP accept them. Machine-readable copy: [reference/commands.json](reference/commands.json). How to use a command: [USER_GUIDE.md](USER_GUIDE.md).

| `clip.warp_poll` | Apply Finished Bend Renders |  |  |  | no | reversible | ok | {} — host-side: applies finished renders whose revision still matches; stale results are dropped — **Limits:** Bend: segments between anchors are joined with a 10 ms crossfade at each anchor (where the two sides differ in phase the level can dip briefly), ratio 0.25..4 per segment, stereo shares one map; listening review is a native gate |
| `clip.warp_set` | Set Warp Anchors | Clip |  |  | yes | reversible | ok | {clip?, anchors: [[src, dst]…] (samples from the clip start; strictly increasing; ≥64 apart; segment ratio 0.25..4)} — replaces the clip's Bend map and queues a pitch-preserving render; the clip keeps its last render until the new one is applied by clip.warp_poll — **Limits:** Bend: segments between anchors are joined with a 10 ms crossfade at each anchor (where the two sides differ in phase the level can dip briefly), ratio 0.25..4 per segment, stereo shares one map; listening review is a native gate |
| `clip.warp_status` | Bend Status |  |  |  | no | reversible | ok | {clip?} — pending/rendering/error state per clip, and the service counters — **Limits:** Bend: segments between anchors are joined with a 10 ms crossfade at each anchor (where the two sides differ in phase the level can dip briefly), ratio 0.25..4 per segment, stereo shares one map; listening review is a native gate |
